def title(name: str | None = None, tags: list[str] | None = None):
    label = name or "untitled"
    items = tags if tags else ["a"]
    return label, items

python-http-timeout.app/client.py:
import requests


def fetch(url):
    session = requests.Session()
    first = session.get(url)
    second = session.post(url, timeout=None)
    return first, second
